node.title: Signo de la desviación
node.summary: Compare a departure from procedure with an independently stated outcome.

relations: The same network can contain harmful local optimization and useful off-map adaptation; their sign becomes clear only after the upstream outcome and its recipient are specified.
La lectura está expresamente propuesta en la fuente; no elimina las obligaciones de seguridad, derechos o legitimidad del servicio.
Field workarounds become more informative when linked to process traces that show their trigger, authorization and effect on the receiving operation.
Una ruta frecuente o no conforme no demuestra necesidad causal ni debe convertirse automáticamente en procedimiento autorizado.
Off-path frequency is a screening measure; load-bearing positive deviation requires evidence that the upstream outcome depended on that path.
La dependencia causal requiere más que conformance checking y no se obtiene suponiendo positiva toda excepción exitosa.
The companion bridge note qualifies Lesson 6: preserve the capability that works under constraint, while testing its architecture rather than treating scarcity itself as a design advantage.
La aclaración editorial no borra la utilidad descrita del caso ni aporta una comparación experimental de soportes.
